message: The return type or a parameter type of a local function in a template cannot be dynamic. Use a specific type, for instance 'object', instead.
title: The signature of a local function in a template cannot use dynamic typing.
rationale: The title has a wrongly capitalized 'Local', a plural 'Signatures' that does not agree with 'Local function', and no final period. The message gives no way forward although the fix is obvious: TemplateAnnotator.VisitLocalFunctionStatement forbids 'dynamic' only in the return type and parameter list, so a specific type works.
